signal: Sonatype released its 2026 State of the Software Supply Chain report in January, flagging a shift from guidance to enforcement in global compliance.

email.body1:
Tom, saw Sonatype's 2026 State of the Software Supply Chain report calling out the shift from guidance to enforcement on compliance.

For financial services that enforcement wave creates more in-market accounts than a team can touch before budgets lock. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Sonatype off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.subject2: meetings to hit your FS number
email.body2:
Tom, quick follow-up for Sonatype.

When compliance becomes enforcement, FS buyers move, but most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to capture that demand. The gap shows up late, and by then it's a scramble to recover the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your financial services book needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Tom, last bit of proof for Sonatype.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to other devsecops vendors. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Tom, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling FS pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. The enforcement-cycle scramble is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a financial services motion? I'll tailor it to Sonatype either way.
